summary: Proofs of the tensor-product laws are well-factored and robust. However, tensor_id_aux and tensor_comp_aux use an undocumented `change` across the Hom/toLinearMap coercion and hand-reprove additivity, instead of reducing to the existing tensor_toLinearMap simp lemma and Mathlib's TensorProduct.map_id / TensorProduct.map_comp.
